Turn insight into campaigns that help people with hearing loss live life to the fullest.

Ready to make an impact that can be heard?

At Demant, we create life-changing technology that helps people with hearing loss stay connected to the conversations and moments that matter. As Campaign Manager in Oticon Brand Management, you will bring that purpose to life through integrated campaigns used across markets worldwide.

Your role

You will help turn business needs and insights into clear briefs, strong creative work and high-quality campaign execution. You will join a dynamic, multinational team where different perspectives fuel better ideas, collaboration comes naturally, and ambitious plans become campaigns with real impact.

What you will do

• Support the development of marketing campaign strategies and concepts based on business needs, brand strategy and audience insight.

• Create clear, inspiring briefs with campaign leads, agencies and internal creative teams.

• Coordinate stakeholders, deliverables, timelines and follow-up across markets and partners.

• Help build integrated, cross-channel marketing packages and ensure brand consistency.

What you bring

• Experience developing and delivering campaigns, in-house or agency-side.

• A structured approach to projects, timelines and budgets.

• The ability to turn varied inputs into focused plans and deliverables.

• Confidence working across teams, markets and agency partners.

• A curious and collaborative mindset, strong eye for quality and sound judgement.

Why join Demant?

Join an international, purpose-driven organisation where brand thinking, creativity and commercial impact come together. Your work will reach markets worldwide and help make a meaningful difference for people with hearing loss.

You will collaborate across functions and borders, learn from skilled colleagues and help create campaigns that support the Demant hearing aid portfolio globally. We also value curiosity, a sense of humour and the ability to keep momentum when the post-it notes start multiplying.

To apply, please submit your CV and a brief motivation through our online application portal by November 12th, 2026.

Our QC lab is growing in activities and looking to recruit an IT System Administrator to join our team onsite in Ballerup.

As IT system administrator at Genmab, you will provide administrative and developmental support to all our QC IT systems in our Quality Control Laboratory.

The laboratory is responsible for supporting Genmab’s innovative products by performing release and stability testing according to ICH guidelines. Systems are mainly the Labvantage Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS), but also the Empower Chromatography software and additional software controlling analytical equipment.

The role requires a detailed understanding of the LIMS and Empower systems used by QC and its maintenance requirements. The IT system administrator will own the system validation packages, the SOPs, and associated training packages.

The position requires compliance with regulatory requirements to cGMP. Unique to this position is the chance to define the way we work with laboratory IT systems at Genmab.

You will be joining a small team of ambitious and professional colleagues within related fields, who can help you settle into your role, and keep the spirit high while performing the important tasks for our laboratory. The laboratory is newly established, so expect a pioneering atmosphere, where you will help adjust the ways of working in an efficiency oriented direction. We expect you to be ambitious, motivated, self-driven, and to be able to make your colleagues shine in an environment of respectful and flexible collaboration.

You will report to the Associate Director of QC Support, Laboratory systems and Equipment.

• Liaison between System Users, Application Managers (IT) & QA.

• Drives Business related aspects of system application operations, design, testing, and improvements.

• Manage user access administration and providing initial and on-going training for users.

• Responsible for practical aspects of maintaining the validated state of GxP systems.

• Ensure data integrity and compliance with company SOPs, requirement specifications, and cGMP regulations.

• Load and configure method templates in LIMS and Empower.

• Perform all aspects of QMS processes – Change Control, Deviations, CAPAs – for software used in QC lab.

• Report achievements and escalate issues.

It is expected that you have at least 5 years of documented professional experience working according to GMP in a QC setting

You have a thorough understanding of the detailed requirements for Software Validation and are up to date with current trends

• 
Experience with qualification of analytical instruments is desirable as you will be the owner of the validation and qualification activities

• 
Experience in leading projects and driving cross-functional initiatives/stakeholders

The Senior Manager, Global Regulatory Labeling Operations plays a key role in leading labeling operations for the EU and Rest of World (RoW) markets, while providing support for U.S. labeling activities. The role is responsible for the timely delivery of compliant, high-quality, submission-ready labeling documents and packaging components, including mockups and artwork, across assigned markets. • Monitor and interpret evolving EU and RoW labeling requirements and industry standards, assess their operational impact, and communicate relevant changes to key stakeholders.

• Utilize labeling, artwork, and electronic document management systems to support content lifecycle management, review and approval workflows, version control, and inspection readiness.

• Partner closely with Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Quality, and other internal and external stakeholders to ensure effective planning and execution of labeling activities.

• Contribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of global end-to-end labeling processes, tools, systems, infrastructure, SOPs, and work instructions.

• Identify opportunities to improve labeling processes and operational efficiency and influence implementation across functions and geographies.

• Represent Global Regulatory Labeling Operations in cross-functional initiatives, governance forums, and strategic discussions that impact labeling processes, systems, and capabilities.

• Mentor and provide guidance to junior team members, supporting knowledge sharing and capability development within the function.

• Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences or a related discipline preferred, or equivalent relevant experience.

• 5+ years of relevant experience within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, with demonstrated experience in regulatory labeling and/or regulatory operations.

• Strong knowledge of EU labeling requirements and experience supporting labeling activities across international or RoW markets.

• Working knowledge of CTD format and content for EU regulatory submissions.

• Experience managing labeling documents, packaging components, artwork, and/or translation and linguistic review activities.

• Experience working with electronic document, labeling, or artwork management systems; experience with Veeva or similar platforms is an advantage.

• Demonstrated ability to manage complex deliverables, priorities, vendors, and timelines in a global, cross-functional environment.

• Strong project and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across functions and geographies.

• Knowledge of U.S. labeling requirements is an advantage.

You will be expected to provide clear direction, establish priorities, and ensure that decisions are translated into action. At the same time, you will remain actively involved in engineering activities, contributing your own technical expertise to complex challenges and important projects.

The Department of Science Education at the University of Copenhagen invites applications for a 2-year postdoctoral position starting 1 March 2027.   We are looking for an engaged and independent researcher to help us develop and test practical ways of strengthening interdisciplinary collaboration in research and education.

  The SPINE project investigates how interdisciplinary collaboration can be better supported within existing academic structures.   You will also contribute to:

   	
• Conducting qualitative research and fieldwork 	
• Analysing and evaluating empirical material and interventions 	
• Working with project partners and stakeholders 	
• Disseminating findings through academic and practice-oriented outputs

• The ability to work independently while contributing actively to a collaborative team 	
• Strong written and oral communication skills 	
• Willingness and ability to travel internationally when required

• Interdisciplinary higher education research 	
• Participatory action research or co-design 	
• Workshop facilitation and stakeholder engagement 	
• Developing or evaluating practical approaches to research and collaboration 	
• Translating research into practical or policy-relevant outputs 	
• Spoken or written Danish, which is an advantage but not a requirement   We welcome candidates from different disciplinary and methodological backgrounds and do not expect applicants to meet every criterion.

   

  What we offer

  You will join an international and collaborative research environment in central Copenhagen and become part of a project with a strong focus on research that makes a practical difference.

  The SPINE project is led by Associate Professor Katrine Ellemose Lindvig at the Section for Higher Education Research and Development, Department of Science Education, University of Copenhagen. The SPINE team consists of the PI, one postdoc, and one PhD student, and works closely with colleagues in a wider research group on Interdisciplinary Higher Education, which includes an additional PhD student. As postdoc, you will work closely together with the researchers in SPINE and this wider group, while also collaborating with external partners and stakeholders.

   

  Application

 Application deadline: 1 November 2026, 23:59 CET

• Your motivation and qualifications for the position, including your relevant research, methodological, and facilitation experience.

_Do you want to join a global fund manager in energy infrastructure investments? If so, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CIP) is currently looking for a Team Assistant to join our Investor Relations & Business Development (IR & BD) team based in Copenhagen.

_**Team

**We are seeking a motivated and organized Team Assistant to support our team members in our Investor Relations & Business Development (IR & BD) team. The IR & BD team at CIP is a global, high-performing unit responsible for all investor interactions and business development activities—from product and fund development to fundraising and client engagement. The team comprises approximately 70 professionals from 15 countries, with backgrounds in investment banking, management consulting, and law.

You will be also a part of a broader Executive Support team, and will report to Heidi Jensen, Sr. Personal Assistant.

**Role

**As a Team Assistant based in CIPs Copenhagen office you will be primarily supporting the EMEA team, within the broader Investor Relations team covering clients across the region. You will play a central role both internally and externally, and you will be the closest go-to person for your team in providing broad administrative support.

**Responsibilities will consist of but are not limited to:

**

• Organizing and maintaining calendars, ensuring alignment in daily schedule and keeping calendars up-to date

• Organizing travel arrangements and logistics and ensuring that roadshows are going smoothly

• Providing broad administrative support, e.g., managing incoming inquiries and scheduling meetings

• Updating CRM systems (e.g., Dealcloud) with relevant data

• Communicating with investors, e.g. replying to emails, sending invitations to events and press releases

**You

**You have around 5 years of relevant experience in administrative or coordinating roles, preferably from a consulting firm, law firm, investment bank, large international company or a Ministry/Government Agency. You thrive in a high-paced work environment and are motivated, thorough, and resourceful, with a high level of professionalism and able to handle confidential material discreetly.

**We look for the following in a candidate

**

• Solid knowledge of Office 365 applications

• Excellent communication and time management skills

• Ability to balance responsibilities in a busy environment across various projects with changing priorities

• Ability to grasp the big picture at the same time being thorough with a high attention to detail

• Ability to manage administrative processes and projects independently, at the same time enjoying sparring and collaborating with the team

• Resilient, service minded, proactive and with a positive can-do attitude

• Experience with CRM tools is a plus

• Project management – investor events, road shows

**The process

**Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

**Building value that matters

**Founded in 2012, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners P/S (CIP) today is the world’s largest dedicated fund manager within greenfield renewable energy investments and a global leader in offshore wind. To date, CIP has developed and constructed more than +50 greenfield renewable projects around the world. CIP is developing a greenfield project portfolio of ~160GW total, and ~16 GW is in operation or under construction. CIP manages 13 funds and has to date raised approximately EUR ~35 billion for investments in energy and associated infrastructure from more than ~200 international institutional investors.

CIP has a multinational team of ~500 full-time employees with extensive experience and knowledge within the fields of renewable energy project development and regulated infrastructure. In addition, CIP has a broad range of competencies within corporate finance, mergers & acquisitions, engineering, construction, project development, and project management.

CIP has built a prominent investment team capable of originating proprietary investment opportunities and executing projects and investments based on the team’s industrial background, large industrial network, and extensive experience in structuring, executing, and managing investments within energy infrastructure. Headquartered in Copenhagen, CIP also operates from key locations across the globe, including offices in Hamburg, Munich, London, Utrecht, New York, Tokyo, Melbourne, Luxembourg, Kuala Lumpur, Seoul and Singapore. In addition, CIP has 17 local project offices globally.

For more information, visit www.cip.com.

Are you ready to take ownership of a Nordic service organisation and build a more integrated, efficient and customer-focused operation across Denmark and Sweden? Join Ramcon and play a key role in strengthening service performance, developing people and processes, and supporting profitable growth in a specialized Nordic LabTech and MedTech  business.

Ramcon is a leading Nordic distributor of advanced solutions within Life Science, Healthcare, Medical Technology, Chemistry and Industrial applications. Since 1988, the company has built its market position through strong supplier partnerships, deep technical expertise and long-term customer relationships. Today, Ramcon distributes its products and solutions in Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Finland and employs approximately 80 employees across Denmark and Sweden. The company operates from offices in Birkerød, Aarhus, Stockholm, and Gothenburg.

Lead and develop the Nordic service organisation

The Service Director Nordic will have overarching responsibility for Ramcon’s Nordic service business and will be a member of the Nordic Leadership Team. The position combines people leadership, operational management and business development, with full P&L responsibility for the service business and responsibility for translating strategic ambitions into efficient operations and measurable results.

With direct responsibility for the Danish service business and overarching leadership of the service organisations in Denmark and Sweden, the Service Director Nordic will work closely with local Service Managers and Service Leaders. The role is responsible for building a stable, scalable and customer-focused Nordic service organisation, while strengthening collaboration with Sales, customers, suppliers and other stakeholders.

Key responsibilities include:

• Operational and direct leadership and development of the Nordic service organisation

• P&L responsibility, budgeting and performance follow-up for the Nordic service business

• Leadership and support of local Service Managers and Service Leaders in daily operations and long-term planning

• Standardisation and continuous improvement of service processes across Denmark and Sweden and preparation for local service presence in Norway and Finland

• Resource coordination and effective utilisation of service capacity across the Nordic organisation

• Development, implementation and follow-up of relevant KPIs

• Overarching responsibility for service contract sales and contract renewals

• Strengthening collaboration between Sales and Service and supporting customer-focused commercial execution

• Development of strong relationships and proactive communication with customers and suppliers

Nordic leadership with operational impact

The Service Director Nordic will play a central role in developing Ramcon’s service organisation into a more integrated Nordic function. Success in the position requires the ability to combine strategic perspective with hands-on operational leadership while creating clear priorities, accountability and collaboration across countries and functions.

The position offers significant influence on how Ramcon delivers service to customers and organises its Nordic resources. The Service Director Nordic will lead an experienced organisation consisting of service engineers, service leadership and service coordination in Denmark and Sweden and will contribute directly to the company’s continued growth and operational development.

Your profile

The ideal candidate is an experienced service leader with a proven track record of creating results through people, structure and disciplined execution in a technical B2B environment. You understand the commercial importance of a high-performing service organisation and can balance customer needs, quality, resource utilization and financial performance.

Furthermore, the successful candidate is expected to have:

• Experience in leading service teams across multiple locations

• Strong people leadership capabilities and experience in developing managers and specialists

• Experience with P&L responsibility, budgeting, KPIs and performance management

• A structured approach to process improvement, resource planning and operational excellence

• Commercial understanding and experience with service agreements, contract sales or renewals

• The ability to build trust and collaboration across customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders

• A pragmatic and action-oriented leadership style combined with a strategic Nordic perspective

Experience from Life Science, Diagnostics, Laboratory Solutions, Medical Technology or another specialised technical service environment would be considered very beneficial.

Apply now

Please note that all enquiries will be handled with confidentiality and that we will reply to the email address from which you send your CV.

Are you passionate about using data, insights, and technology to drive growth, influence strategy, and unlock commercial opportunities? Then you could be the Senior Manager, Global eCommerce Analytics & Insights we're looking for.

_As Senior Manager, Global eCommerce Analytics & Insights, you will play a pivotal role in defining and driving Pandora's global eCommerce analytics agenda. This is a highly visible leadership position at the intersection of analytics, commercial strategy, and digital growth.

You will act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders across Global eCommerce, helping shape business decisions through data-driven insights and strategic recommendations. Leveraging a deep understanding of digital performance, customer behaviour, and commercial drivers, you will identify opportunities to accelerate growth, optimise performance, and strengthen Pandora's global eCommerce business.

Leading a team of analytics professionals, you will combine strategic thinking, business acumen, and analytical expertise to ensure data remains at the heart of decision-making across the organisation.

**Key Responsibilities

**Commercial insights & business partnering

eCommerce analytics platforms

**

• Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to engage and influence both technical and non-technical audiences.

**We Hope To See That You Are

**

**Your new team

**

**We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

**About The Role

**We are looking for an AIT Quality Engineer to join our AIT Project Quality Management team. In this role, you will be responsible for planning, driving, and delivering validation and quality activities within complex Automation and IT projects in the pharmaceutical and life science industry.

You will work as part of multidisciplinary project teams and act as a trusted advisor on validation strategy, GMP compliance, quality risk management, and project quality execution from project initiation through to handover. The role combines hands-on technical validation expertise with project quality management responsibilities, ensuring that deliverables, quality expectations, timelines, and customer requirements are aligned throughout the project lifecycle.

Location Denmark - Kalundborg

Experience Minimum 5 Years

• Executing qualification and testing activities while ensuring compliance with GMP requirements, industry standards, and customer expectations.

• Collaborating with customers, suppliers, and project teams throughout FAT, SAT, commissioning, validation, and handover.

• Managing validation risks, deviations, compliance issues, and mitigation actions across projects.

**Who You Are

**We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• Able to work independently while building strong relationships with stakeholders.

• Comfortable balancing compliance, quality, timelines, and project risks.

• Eager to share knowledge and support the development of colleagues.

• Skilled at communicating complex validation topics in a practical way.

• Motivated by collaboration and delivering high-quality results in project environments.

• Experience within CQV, validation, GMP, QA, or project quality management in the pharmaceutical, biotech, or life science industry.

• Hands-on experience preparing and reviewing validation documentation, including URS, FS/DS, SVP, IQ/OQ/PQ, risk assessments, and test protocols.

• Ability to advise customers and project teams on validation strategy, compliance risks, and quality-related decisions.
